text: What's a dope rhyme if you ain't got skills? Why you front hard when you just ain't real? How you live right now? I know what a dealer don't make no sense to me, Jack. Yo, hip-hop do opt to cold breeze. Motown soul sound caught up in the rhymes. Rhymes, rhymes, hungry and alone. Screaming into Dave Dax and broken headphones. Rapping with the vision of the future generation. Listening to my sound.
